run_cbps_weighting: fit a covariate balancing propensity score model to compute sample weights that balance covariates against a target population
compute_pseudo_weights_from_logit_probs: compute pseudo weights from logit probabilities, design weights, and a target population indicator vector
compute_gmm_loss: compute the generalized method of moments loss given beta coefficients, covariates, design weights, and a target indicator
compute_balance_loss: compute the covariate balance loss given beta coefficients, covariate matrix, design weights, target indicator, and XtX inverse
compute_design_effect: compute the design effect of estimated weights on the sample given beta coefficients and design weights
